{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders
sales_clean = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute mean age of customers who converted
# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales_clean[sales_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
converted_customers_valid_age = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = converted_customers_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
